drift_summary: Edit button DROPPED — clicking any map label now auto-enters polyline edit mode (rev 15 d16f6dc + rev 21 retained)
Reassign-to renamed Reassign (i18n key polylineEdit.reassignTo → polylineEdit.reassign)
Clear selection icon unified to minus-circle in all states (was bare 'x' in edit mode, minus-circle in State E)
Reassign trigger and ⋯ More trigger moved INSIDE their popover wrappers (each cluster is one flex child for uniform 12px gap)
Map style menu button uses programmatic open (no commandFor) — popover closes via removeAttribute + modal opens via showOverlay()
Fix #1 (button morph): label collapses to max-width:0 by default, expands on hover; controlled by .mapBlockFooterRight + .mapBlockFooterRightFullscreen parent classes (rev 21)
